scientific_purpose: One integrated 101226-parameter native ES-WAM capability study: learn original real next-joint physical state, supervised movement discrimination and next already-observed logged qpos change with a source-causal velocity feature and conservative shrinkage. Compare DEV to source-matched persistence and original ME076/ESWAM002/ME077/ME078/ME079 frozen scores where definitions match. No fair architecture superiority, causal action or independent source claim.

real_world_source.name: BodenAI/RW-RL-HIL-Dataset, frozen revision 9290f5a96dc91ea58256e81d9ce2dd9621890b51, original ME064 registered five authentic tasks previously exposed FIT 160 episodes; CC-BY-4.0 with publisher attribution

training_budget.selection: frozen SHA256 task/episode lexicographic 24 FIT / 8 previously exposed original FIT-DEV per task
training_budget.train_window_sampling: seeded equal-task task round robin with half outcome-change >0.025 physical mean units and half uniform, within FIT only
training_budget.checkpoint: single final model per seed after 640 guarded updates, Git saved with original model/optimizer/torch/numpy/python RNG and raw real forecasts
training_budget.auxiliary_target: logged future issued action[t] at scoring origin t; training only; not input to the forecast (last input is action[t-1])
training_budget.loss: source real normalized next-state Laplace NLL plus 0.5 physical-normalized MAE plus 0.20 train-prior-importance-weighted movement BCE plus 0.05 next recorded-action SmoothL1; no future movement flag as feature
training_budget.sampling: four consecutive 160-step rounds from ORIGINAL ME076 FIT-only source sampler, seed seed+round*100000; no additional raw episodes; every sampled origin authentic
training_budget.action_target: actual next recorded issued qpos[t] supervised target only; previous a[t-1] input
training_budget.motion_target: real mean physical 14D |x[t+1]-x[t]| >=0.025, target only; FIT source natural movement frequency used for training risk importance correction

primary_development_measure: physical-unit 14D H1 MAE on exactly original 960 factual sources cases, motion-rich/stationary stratification, proper Laplace NLL, natural-population Brier/AP for risk, next-command MAE versus repeat-last
measurable_promotion_rule: DEV-only ability if both overall and movement-rich physical MAE <=.95 source-matched persistence and stationary MAE<=1.10 frozen ME077; action imitation must beat exact repeat-last-action on same source; independent claim requires untouched externally sourced holdout and matched original data/compute controls
source_train_fit_qualification: metadata and normalized state/action computed only from designated FIT episode members; source fingerprint includes entire original five-task FIT 160 archive but eval rows never used for normalization
guard: live instantiated whole model pre-first-update and each guarded optimizer step, Git checkpoint + original per-case recorded outcomes and independent zero-fit replay
strict_no_claims: no actual command execution or causal action
no masked future motion feature at inference
no frozen original ME073/ME076/ME077/ME078/ME079 checkpoint modifications
no fresh independent physical site or protected TEST
